title: What Real Estate Playbook Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of real estate playbook: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Real estate investing: start with education, run the numbers (1% rule, cap rate), and buy cash-flowing properties in markets you understand. Leverage magnifies gains and losses.

Why it matters: 1% rule: monthly rent ~1% of purchase price (screening tool) Cap rate = net operating income / price

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.
facts: Real estate investing: start with education, run the numbers (1% rule, cap rate), and buy cash-flowing properties in markets you understand. Leverage magnifies gains and losses.
1% rule: monthly rent ~1% of purchase price (screening tool)
Cap rate = net operating income / price
Cash flow = rent minus ALL expenses (PITI + vacancy + repairs + capex)
House-hacking: live in one unit, rent others

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Real Estate Playbook
summary: Start real estate playbook this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Learn: books, local meetups, 100 property analyses
2. Pick a strategy (buy-hold, house-hack, flip)
3. Pick a market you understand
4. Build your team: agent, lender, contractor
5. Analyze 100 deals; offer on 10; buy 1

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: Learn: books, local meetups, 100 property analyses
Build your team: agent, lender, contractor

title: Common Real Estate Playbook Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with real estate playbook — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- No reserves (vacancy/repairs kill) → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Over-leveraging → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Skipping inspections → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Emotional buying → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

title: Real Estate Playbook: Safety, Legal, and Fine Print
summary: What to watch out for with real estate playbook: safety, contracts, and fine print.
body:
Read before you act: No reserves (vacancy/repairs kill) And: Over-leveraging

General rules: get agreements in writing, understand what you're signing, keep records of money in and out, and know when a professional (lawyer, accountant, vet, doctor — depending on the domain) is worth the fee. An hour of professional advice beats a month of fixing.
